name: usb_state
cmd: echo '--- android_usb ---'; cat /sys/class/android_usb/android0/state 2>/dev/null; cat /sys/class/android_usb/android0/functions 2>/dev/null; echo '--- usb devices ---'; ls /sys/bus/usb/devices/ 2>/dev/null; echo '--- usbmon ---'; cat /sys/kernel/debug/usb/usbmon/0u 2>/dev/null | head -3
